fusions.name: Gap Thrust
fusions.desc: You rush the target and thrust through its guard, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thorn Flurry
fusions.desc: Looses 3 thorns at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Steady Nerve
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Chained Prick
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
